content:
Vue3响应式修复完成：
1. chatUnreadMap: ref({})属性赋值改为整体替换 `{ ...chatUnreadMap.value, [key]: value }` (4处)
2. chatJoinedRooms: ref(new Set())改为ref([])，add/delete/has改为push+filter+includes (6处)
3. ChatPanel.vue: joinedRooms?.has?.()改为joinedRooms?.includes?.()

关键：Vue3的ref包裹对象/数组时，直接修改内部属性/调用Set方法不触发响应式，必须整体替换引用。
